_ordering_rationale: Ordre PV : Internet clients = base d'abonnes core cable, mobile lines = hypercroissance, ARPU = monetisation, revenue + EBITDA = financiers, capex = lourdeur infra.

kpis.signal: Pic 30.6M en 2023, contraction 2024 sous concurrence fiber + FWA (T-Mobile/Verizon)
kpis.description_fr: Abonnes Internet residentiels + SMB (Spectrum). Base d'abonnes principale, generateur primaire CA cable.
kpis.description_en: Residential + SMB Internet subscribers (Spectrum). Core sub base, primary cable revenue driver.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance MVNO sur reseau Verizon, segment relais croissance
kpis.description_fr: Lignes Spectrum Mobile (MVNO sur Verizon). Hypercroissance, vecteur principal d'expansion ARPU et churn reduction.
kpis.description_en: Spectrum Mobile lines (MVNO on Verizon). Hypergrowth segment, primary lever for ARPU expansion and churn reduction.

kpis.signal: Croissance ARPU regulière malgre baisse video, mix Internet/mobile favorable
kpis.description_fr: Revenu mensuel moyen par abonne residentiel. Indicateur cle de monetisation, soutenu par bundle Internet + mobile.
kpis.description_en: Monthly average revenue per residential customer. Key monetization metric, supported by Internet + mobile bundling.

kpis.signal: Croissance ralentie, plafonnement broadband, mobile relais
kpis.description_fr: CA total Charter Communications (Internet + Video + Voice + Mobile + Advertising + Commercial).
kpis.description_en: Charter Communications total revenue (Internet + Video + Voice + Mobile + Advertising + Commercial).

kpis.signal: Marge EBITDA ~41%, generation cash robuste qui alimente buybacks
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA ajuste, principal indicateur de profitabilite operationnelle des cablo-operateurs. Sert au de-leveraging et rachat actions.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted EBITDA, key operational profitability metric for cable operators. Funds de-leveraging and buybacks.

kpis.signal: Erosion progressive depuis pic 2022, pression cord-cutting + FWA
kpis.description_fr: Total des relations clients residentielles + SMB (hors entreprise et mobile-only). Mesure plus large que les seuls abonnes Internet.
kpis.description_en: Total residential + SMB customer relationships (ex enterprise and mobile-only). Broader than just Internet subs.
